## Controls and player understanding

Use the exact read-only helpers in CORE evidence and current source; never duplicate eligibility. The important new APIs are `materialStoragePreview`, `cellRechargePreview`, `distractionPreview`, `dartPerformance`, `installModuleRefusal`, `removeModuleRefusal`, and existing `fabricationContainers`/`available`/`craftingRefusal`/`containerAccessible`. The view already owns WorldQueries. New command shapes are `recharge-cells`, `store-materials{from,to}`, `install-module{vehicleId,itemId}`, `remove-module{vehicleId,itemId}`. Keep G as the existing paid distraction command.

1. **Pulse and reserve choice.** Before use, communicate G's25-point cost from one carried/controlled-hold cell, which accessible cell will pay, and remaining charge. Do not display a remote cell as available or offer a free pulse while active. The explicit bench recharge action must be findable before owning a vessel; it replenishes local cells only, not the hull battery/health/air. Separate that action from physically approaching a craft for reserve power or supported service. Correct stale “carry locker cells first”/free reusable distraction advice. Keep quiet/cover/retreat visible as no-charge options. HUD summary should remain compact; full details belong in preparation panels/notebook.
2. **Local materials.** Bench ingredient counts and refusals use exactly the simulation's eligible set, including this site's supported cradle hold. Name that source so players understand why cargo can fund a build from the bench. Remove the obsolete transfer-cargo-first instruction. An unrestored workshop locker remains locked; explain use of carried/local buoy materials without granting access.
3. **Explicit bulk storage.** Offer a readable source→destination “Store materials” action for locally accessible non-equipment containers. Show the shared preview's actual whole-stack quantities/total CU and why it refuses; preserve meals/cells/tools/modules. Avoid an indiscriminate grid of every empty source/destination pair. Keep individual transfers and keyboard focus tied to semantic command operands through inventory reshuffles; Return is the safe fallback when the action disappears. A refusal must preserve selection/context and show its reason.
4. **A visible useful refit.** Show acoustic trim as crafted/stored/installed according to actual item and module reference, not just `knowledge.crafted`. Installing consumes one of two sockets and2 CU in that Dart hold; quiet3→4.2, normal8 unchanged, boost11→9 m/s. This is faster quiet travel, not silent normal cruise or a pressure upgrade. Use `dartPerformance` and registry values; show meaningful before/after and removal option. When disabled, offer the eligible local collar removal so intact transfer precedes frame salvage. Never imply installed items can be transferred directly. Current receipt data records completion, **not actual past paid quantities**: completed recipes must not label today's costs as what an old save spent. Label current recipe/reference costs honestly or omit them after completion; distinguish “fabricated” from “installed”.
5. **Feedback voice.** Prefer action/outcome/next-step prose. Call protected maintenance “rescue stock” without changing numeric semantics. Preserve costs, local-access restrictions, refusal atomicity, recovery limitations and urgent information. Do not replace an actionable error with generic flavor. Critical low air/power/depth/damage, unsaved-session Export and graphics recovery remain visible and operable even with captions off.

## Clues and encounter cues

Keep discovery ambiguous and grounded. Opening captions may describe alarms, restraint, shaking, dark water and recovering visibility without asserting the direction-of-arrival conclusion. Keep the actual underlying event/physical animation and short actionable sequence; no false crash or new cutscene machinery. C01 may offer competing interpretations consistent with the canon instead of confidently resolving them. Root accepts the protected SP-01 direction for this restrained wording pass; later facts/chronology remain fixed.

C03/C04 leads should point to a recognizable existing region/landmark or observation. Move suit/power preparation advice into preparation/hints, retaining regional discovery and voluntary guidance. The Basin lead remains future work in this incomplete M1 build; do not fabricate a currently explorable second destination. C04's real immediate payoff is the optional trim using Canopy materials; make that available next action understandable. Preserve C03-before-C02 behavior and optional-note independence. Keep the exact saved provenance strings and current observations. No new source-dependent prose requiring unimplemented ecology.

For the hunter, inspect the actual warning→investigation presentation before changing it. Existing directional call audio, directional HUD warning and fins should together communicate attention; shorten didactic mid-encounter text if useful while keeping readable warning/direction. Detailed tactics and pulse costs belong in voluntary preparation. Do not hide critical warnings when captions are off or require sound/color alone. Keep existing audible cue origin and avoid claims about the actual mix on a muted host. If current fins already read clearly at the game camera, retain them and show evidence; a tiny animation revision is optional, not a new creature model.
